propositions: An optional isolated backfill adapter mines local Claude Code transcripts to reconstruct environment/integration diagnosis history without dependency on the core metrics command.

Error-signature grep over transcript JSONL files matches canonical patterns (ModuleNotFoundError, ConnectionError, timed out, HTTP 429, etc.) and deterministically routes matches to a classification enum via keyword/regex rules, with no LLM call.
Every emitted classified record carries source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified labels to segregate low-confidence backfill data from authoritative structural metrics.
The core metrics package (registry.py, __init__.py) must not import the transcript adapter to maintain portability; the adapter is only imported by the optional backfill script.

Unit tests verify fixture JSONL transcripts with known error signatures are extracted and classified deterministically into the correct enum value, clean transcripts yield none, and the classification enum contains exactly the five defined values (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none).
